name: Chuu Shite...
source:
- Kiss?
- Yup. It means draw one month close to another month.
- Why people kiss?
- I do not know, but ... I tried it yesterday
- Does it tickle?
- Yup. My mouth was licked as if it was going to be eaten
- Fuwa ...
- So, let's try it.
- Yup…
And that girl pulled her lips towards me and closed her eyes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“亲一下？”
“嗯。就是让一个月和另一个月靠得很近。”
“人为什么要接吻？”
“我也不知道，不过…昨天试过一次。”
“会痒吗？”
“嗯。嘴巴被舔了，好像要被吃掉一样。”
“呼哇…”
“那我们也试试看吧。”
“嗯…”
说着，那个女孩把嘴唇凑向我，闭上了眼睛。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
